name: Kranti Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2019, Kranti Industries Limited is a precision machining company in the auto ancillary and allied sectors[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is an OEM supplier of Critical Machined Components to Indian and global automobile companies. It manufactures machines casting for transmission, axles, chassis, engines, and other parts for the automotive industry including electric vehicles.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.89% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.63% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -12.3%
